_comment: Merge these into package.json -> config.custom of the theme (Ghost allows 20 custom settings total). Values are typed in Ghost Admin > Design & branding > Site-wide; the theme renders them via theme-seo-head.hbs.

google_site_verification.description: SEO: Google Search Console verification code (only the content= value of the HTML tag)

bing_site_verification.description: SEO: Bing Webmaster Tools verification code (msvalidate.01 content)

ga4_measurement_id.description: SEO: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). Empty = analytics off. Sets cookies: needs consent banner under GDPR/LGPD

facebook_domain_verification.description: SEO: Meta (Facebook) domain verification code (facebook-domain-verification content)

meta_pixel_id.description: SEO: Meta Pixel ID (numeric). Empty = pixel off. Only for sites running Meta Ads; needs consent under GDPR/LGPD
